verdict.rationale: The UK IPO is a government intellectual-property registry offering filing, search, renewal and tracking services. It is not an automation or workflow platform, so letting users schedule recurring jobs or workflows is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence shows no first-party scheduling capability that would make the axis apply; the 'Get emails' subscription and 'Track a trade mark' are notification and lookup features, not user-defined recurring jobs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
